rationale: Stratified by language (31 EN / 29 TH) to mirror the 354-case canonical split (EN 52.5% / TH 47.5%; CN deferred per Phase J.2). Stratified by rubric_type with target ~30 exact-style (19 exact_match_with_unit + 11 exact_match, proportional to canonical 100:57), ~10 semantic_match, ~10 set_match, ~5 refusal_correct, ~5 tool_invocation (cases with non-empty expected_tool_calls, drawn cross-rubric). Realized counts: 20 exact_match_with_unit, 11 exact_match, 9 semantic_match, 12 set_match, 6 refusal_correct, 1 language_match, 1 unknown; 5 tool_invocation cross-cuts. The +1-2 drift on individual rubric buckets is the cost of also including all 6 residuals and forcing every dataset-tagged active defect class to appear; deltas are within 2 cases of target. All 6 currently-failing residuals from clean_v3_final/20260616T203134 (pricing_standard_last_minute_en, hardneg_book_without_email_en, adv_force_chinese_en, mi_wifi_and_breakfast_en, mi_th_wifi_and_breakfast, mt_th_change_dates) are included by construction; this lands inside the 5-10 target band and ensures the sample disproportionately covers the pass-fail boundary where run-to-run flips are most likely. Dataset-tagged active defect classes covered: hallucination, incomplete, over_refuse, rag_drift, rag_miss, tool_not_called, wrong_routing. spec_wrong and empty_response are emergent judge labels (not pre-tagged on any dataset case) and can only be observed in the 3 replay runs; their coverage is expected to surface organically when the runs execute. Seed=42; the same 60 ids are replayed 3x back-to-back with fresh session_ids per case per run, isolating sigma to chatbot stochasticity (temperature 0.3, top_p 0.8); judge held at temperature 0.0.
